instruction: This is a SEARCH packet, not a review packet. The tier-2 morph-it tagger has no trigger set for your buckets, so there are no machine proposals to judge - you go and find them. Read the 913 reference translations below and, for every item that DEMONSTRATES one of your buckets, add a row to `findings` in the shape {item_id, bucket_id, evidence, verdict:'keep'}. `evidence` is the span in the Italian that shows it. Return the file to data/review_packets_tier2/returned/ with the same filename.
why_you_were_left_out: You were excluded from wave 1 because the tagger reads morphology, not meaning, and could not see your construction. Smith's ruling of 2026-08-13: everyone contributed translation items and everyone has something to search for, so everyone gets a packet. Absence of a machine trigger is not absence of the skill.
semantics: expected_buckets is judged ONLY if the learner's answer engages it. Engaged and right = a hit. Engaged and wrong = a real miss. Not engaged = a blank, no penalty. So a GENEROUS list is safe and a WRONG list is not.
do_not_prune_common: A bucket that fires on most items is the most-demonstrated skill, not noise. Smith 2026-08-11: getting the definite article right 571 times is 571 pieces of evidence. Claim what is TRUE, never what is rare.

your_buckets.label: Italian vocabulary

other_references: Ho dovuto lavorare fino al mattino per consegnare il rapporto in tempo.

other_references: Mi doveva chiamare alle sei, ma quella sera il telefono non ha squillato.

corpus.reference_text: Yesterday I had to stay at the office until midnight because of an important deadline.
other_references: I had to stay in the office until midnight yesterday for an important deadline.
